sequence.text: Starts when someone seems too high, out of your zone, and you fear them. Winds down when you just relax and let your mind go.

meme.text: When I feel a hint of anxiety the alarms all go off, like a prison with an escapee.

world.text: All-absorbing. Tense. Oppositional. Me vs. you. The other person becomes enemy #1, with a story about them that’s very narrow.

sequence.text: Pre-anger first: dissembling, ramping up, still trying to escape the state. Then anger. Then post-anger, putting down the gloves.

meme.text: A kettle screaming on the stove.

does.text: Actions and tactics directed at entertaining and appeasing the partner, or making them think I am something worthy.

sequence.text: Starts with visibility; winds down when contact replaces evaluation.

meme.text: An actor checking the audience after every line.

body.text: Like I’m just inhabiting my body like an invader.

world.text: As you get close to someone, you elevate them, making them royalty, while lowering yourself. You feel like you have to prove your worth or earn their approval.

does.text: Overthink. Second-guess myself. Focus too much on pleasing them.

sequence.text: Starts after the beginning, as you get close. It happens gradually. Winds down when I hold onto my frame and stay myself.

meme.text: A guy reading his lines off a boyfriend script.

does.text: Agree, please, smooth things over, brace for criticism.

sequence.text: Starts with someone to connect with; winds down when the fear of disappointing them loosens.

meme.text: A dog rolling over before anyone has said a word.

body.text: Bright face, up energy, a guard on duty underneath.

does.text: Talk people up, fill silences, smooth things over, keep everyone comfortable.

sequence.text: Starts when someone looks uncomfortable; winds down when the guard steps off and I can feel and relax.

meme.text: A party host who never gets to sit down.

does.text: Project the model onto the person, evaluate, say what I like.

sequence.text: Starts as you continue dating: out of positive vibes and feeling warm, into the judgments world. Winds down when you’re just friends.

meme.text: A buyer walking through a house with a clipboard.

does.text: Set up a goal, then judge everything against it. Plan to go from A to B. Any deviation is frustrating.

sequence.text: Starts when you think you’re not there and get tight. Winds down when you ask: what if nothing is actually wrong?

meme.text: A runner checking the finish line instead of running.

body.text: We get so stressed out quietly.

world.text: So much to keep track of. Things to avoid: shame, social humiliation, pain and fear. Not wanting to look weird.

sequence.text: Starts before you notice: you come in already wanting a lot of things. Winds down when you take a break from the management and thinking.

meme.text: Someone lugging a full suitcase around without noticing they’re holding it.

world.text: We’re all searching all the time to feel different and comfortable.

sequence.text: Activated when I sit down to be still. Winds down by non-searching: you just stop searching for things.

meme.text: A flashlight sweeping a room that’s already lit.

body.text: Restless pressure, forward lean, inability to settle.

sequence.text: Starts with life reflection/comparison; winds down through action, perspective, or letting the verdict drop.

meme.text: A Sunday afternoon wearing a performance review badge.

body.text: Puffed up, on, watching for the reaction.

thinking.text: Pretending to be the person you think you’re supposed to be, based on what you think is cool.

does.text: Subtly competing, comparing, or shrinking myself.

sequence.text: Starts with something to prove or achieve. Winds down when the need to prove yourself drops. When it drops, something opens.

meme.text: A peacock fanning its tail at a dinner party.

does.text: Fist pump, wave the arms, a loud whew. Then braver acts: asking someone out, asking for a raise, singing karaoke.

sequence.text: Starts after focus, with a celebratory gesture. Lasts 1–4 days, tapering off after day 1.

meme.text: A gymnast sticking the landing, arms up.

thinking.text: It’s being done to me. Me vs. them. Simple.

does.text: Resent, replay, keep score, reject the other.

sequence.text: Starts as a dance where people trigger old Saran in each other. Once it’s established, it takes conscious effort to break. It has momentum: the pattern continues even after you find out you were wrong.

meme.text: The same sad song on repeat.

body.text: Closed off, cold eyes, turned away.

does.text: A tendency to disagree. No closeness, no overlap of self and other.

sequence.text: Starts when expectation narratives of conflict are activated by a possible outgroup member. Winds down when trust comes back.

meme.text: A bouncer who has already decided you’re not on the list.

world.text: Once we’ve calmed down, we see that it’s all bullshit. What we thought about the person was in our head.

sequence.text: Starts when you put down the gloves and look into your feelings: what is this? Opens new options. You can let go of habitual conflicts and patterns.

body.text: Relaxed in your shoulders. Musculature let go. Breathing slowed down a bit. Smooth.

thinking.text: An empty mind is a just chilling mind. Not filled with checking or trying to hold onto something.

world.text: Happy and self-sufficient and at rest. Calm. Open.

does.text: Pay attention to your environment, but stay chill. Not in goal mode.

sequence.text: Starts when the goal drops and the body settles; winds down when a task or worry pulls you back into goal mode.

meme.text: A sea otter floating on its back.

does.text: One thing at a time. Sit, eat, walk, talk.

sequence.text: Starts when the doing stops; winds down when a goal or worry picks the doing back up.

meme.text: A cat asleep in a patch of sun.
